prompt: Use case: compositing. Three true-color chart from ONLY supplied accepted color photos:1AllBlack,2BlackSilver,3WhiteGreen. Three entire photograph tiles in a spacious balanced square white grid; contain-fit ALL shoes and original lower legs/socks within tiles, do not normalize poses. Exact title 'COLOR & SIZE OPTIONS'; exact labels 'All Black' / 'Black / Silver' / 'White / Green'; footer 'EU 36–48' / 'Confirm color and size mix for quotation'. No other shoe images. Exact photographed Luqi033 product only: visible mesh panels surrounded by broad angular continuous side overlays, separate curved toe overlays, ordinary flat lace-up eyelets, padded low collar, true heel pull loop and low sole with curved ridges. WhiteGreen has white mesh/white side overlays/pale-grey toe overlays, dark-green collar/heel and mustard-yellow outsole; BlackSilver has black mesh with silver broad angular overlay and black sole; AllBlack black mesh/black overlays/black sole. Preserve exact shoe count, original pose, actual occlusion, mesh weave, stitching, seam positions, toe and sole shape. Never turn into050 eye/grid narrow decorations,053 diagonal slots,2626 broad twin bands or213 toggle. Remove pasted source marketing/header/footer/arrows/badges/Trend/Classic/Chinese text, not real product features or photographed apparel. No model/supplier labels (NO Luqi033), no secondary cutout shoe miniatures, no invented views or new macro. No composition/rubber/EVA/weight/grip/cushioning/waterproof/medical/certification claims. Square1:1 white/warm-white quiet B2B canvas. Complete original photographed shoe edges with generous margins; retain natural partial occlusion without completing hidden parts. Use ONLY exact requested text and supplied original photo(s). Critical revision: prior chart squeezed WhiteGreen heel against right tile/canvas edge; REJECT that. Generous internal whitespace around EACH full source photograph. Three contained photo tiles, each original photo scaled to maximum70% of tile width and80% of tile height, center within tile; use adequate tile height. Never fill-crop or enlarge shoes. At least50px blank padding between any shoe and a tile's left/right edge, and60px between any shoe and outer canvas edge. If space limited reduce complete source photo uniformly, do not clip or reconstruct heels/toes. All six shoes and original lower legs must remain entire as supplied.
